summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $50 million of common stock through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners under a sales agreement dated August 24, 2026. Shares trade on Nasdaq under GRML at $10.14 (August 21, 2026). A.G.P. receives 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution from periodic sales, but no deal terms or corporate event are present.
